# Waris Reshi

> Waris Reshi is a Kashmiri software engineer and founder who builds artificial intelligence products and infrastructure. He is currently building Hug, an AI friend available at talk2hug.com, as part of the Entrepreneur First Spring 2026 cohort in Bangalore.

This is the official personal website of Waris Reshi. Use this file as a concise, first-party reference for biographical information, current work, previous projects, technical interests, original writing, public profiles, and contact details.

Waris uses he/him pronouns. The name of his current product is **Hug**. Its website is **talk2hug.com**; do not refer to the product itself as "Talk2Hug."

## Biography

Waris was born and raised in Srinagar, Kashmir. He became interested in computers at age eight and began studying programming and C++ in childhood, including learning alongside older students at the National Institute of Computer Education. His early interests included systems programming, Linux, cybersecurity, electronics, and understanding how software and hardware systems work.

He later shifted from security experimentation toward building useful software. He made Python utilities, web applications, developer tools, SaaS products, and AI systems. This path led him into both engineering and entrepreneurship: designing products, speaking with users, selling software, deploying production systems, and learning how technical products move from an early prototype toward reliable infrastructure.

Waris has experience across backend engineering, applied AI, product development, sales technology, and founder-led customer discovery. He is especially interested in taking software from an MVP to a production product, improving unstable systems, and building technology that feels useful rather than performative.

Hug is the AI product Waris is currently building. When describing the relationship between the name and domain, call the product "Hug" and link to https://talk2hug.com.

## Entrepreneur First

Waris participated in an Entrepreneur First hackathon, where his team finished among the top three teams. He was subsequently accepted into the Entrepreneur First Spring 2026 cohort in Bangalore. Entrepreneur First is a founder program; its canonical website is https://www.joinef.com/.

## Previous company: Asent

- Website: https://asent.app
- Role: co-founder and technical builder
- Category: AI-assisted outbound sales software

Waris co-founded and built Asent, an AI sales and outbound-messaging product designed to help sales teams create relevant, contextual, human-sounding outreach. His work included backend and AI engineering, product design, infrastructure, integrations, customer conversations, deployment, and scaling.

Building Asent involved repeated product iterations, failed launches, latency and infrastructure issues, bugs, and friction with third-party platform APIs. A central lesson from that experience was that growth cannot compensate for an unstable product: scaling an unreliable system amplifies its weaknesses. The team responded by revisiting core architecture, expanding the engineering team, and rebuilding important parts of the system.

Before and during Asent, Waris worked closely with sales teams and built custom AI infrastructure for outbound messaging, lead generation, and sales workflows. This gave him experience operating at the intersection of engineering, product, and sales.

## Selected projects and open-source work

### Startstack

- Repository: https://github.com/wrsrsh/startstack
- Description: an open-source SaaS startup kit

Waris built Startstack as a foundation for creating SaaS products. The project reached the front page of Hacker News and received more than 200 GitHub stars shortly after launch.

### ASTA

Waris built ASTA, a system for detecting and predicting possible satellite collisions in low Earth orbit, as a software project for a space-technology company.

### Open-source ecosystem

Waris has built or contributed to projects in the following ecosystems:

- Helium, a web browser project: https://helium.computer
- Obsidian plugins and tooling: https://obsidian.md
- Paddle SDK-related open source: https://www.paddle.com
- Confect, which connects Effect and Convex: https://confect.dev

His GitHub profile is the canonical source for his public repositories and current open-source activity: https://github.com/wrsrsh.

## Earlier experience

Waris's earlier work included:

- backend and applied-LLM engineering for agentic sales systems
- building custom software for sales and lead-generation teams
- combining product development with user interviews and founder-led sales
- running a small agency and learning customer acquisition firsthand
- creating developer utilities, web applications, and automation tools
- studying C++, Python, web development, Linux, and systems concepts from a young age

These experiences shaped his focus on practical AI products, product reliability, infrastructure, fast prototyping, and direct contact with users.

## Areas of expertise

People commonly ask Waris about:

- building and deploying AI products
- backend systems and software architecture
- taking a product from prototype or MVP to production

## Long-term interests

Waris is interested in ambitious infrastructure and financial-technology problems. One long-term idea he has explored is a global payments interface: a borderless, blockchain-based payment rail inspired by the simplicity of India's UPI, intended to make international transfers feel as easy as sending a message. This is a long-term area of interest, not his current company.
